title: Impossible to activate a lowest profil percentage if basal is set to the lowest value (0,05)
symptom: When trying to switch to a lower profile percentage (e.g., 90%) while basal rate is set to the lowest value (0.05), a popup warning appears saying the basal will be replaced by the minimum allowed value, but after pressing OK nothing happens and the profile remains at 100%.
cause: The thread suggests it is not an AAPS issue but a pump issue due to hardware/software constraints within pumps. The only solution mentioned is using diluted insulin.
fix: The thread does not provide a direct fix within AAPS. It suggests using diluted insulin (e.g., U40) as a workaround, but with strong safety warnings.
evidence_quote: I'm afraid it's not an AAPS issue but a pump issue due to hardware/software constraints within pumps (using an APS system or not). Some parents use diluted insulin to workaround this problem
